concept.title: Filters Overview
concept.shortdesc: Filters modify a single source's video or audio without affecting the rest of the scene.

conbody.p: Filters are attached to an individual source (or to a scene, for scene-wide effects) and are applied in order from top to bottom of the filter list. Video filters and audio filters are listed separately because a source can have both at once.
Common video filters include Chroma Key, Color Correction, Sharpen, Crop/Pad, Scroll, and LUT application. Common audio filters include Noise Suppression, Noise Gate, Compressor, and Limiter.
conbody.note: Filter order matters. For example, a Crop/Pad filter placed before a Chroma Key filter crops the image before the key is calculated; placed after, it crops the already-keyed result.
